name: 13126 · Oswego, NY
findings: ZIP 13126 (Oswego) has 135 nonprofit organizations. 73 of them (54%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 63 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (36% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 13126 (Oswego) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
47% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 13126 (Oswego) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.5 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 63 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are groups to join so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Social and fraternal organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 7 social and fraternal organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity on their websites. Many may still offer them without saying so online, or have no website at all.
